pendingApproval.title: Your account is ready
pendingApproval.description: Registration is complete. An administrator will approve your access. You do not need to do anything else.

accountStep.title: Account created
accountStep.description: You have signed in to Invessiv successfully.

accessStep.title: Administrator approval
accessStep.description: Once your access is approved, the areas intended for you will become available.

pendingApproval.note: You can close this page. We will check your access automatically the next time you return.

inactive.title: Your workspace access is deactivated
inactive.description: Your account still exists in the system, but it cannot currently access the workspace.

accountStep.title: Account exists
accountStep.description: You do not need to create a new account.

accessStep.title: Access deactivated
accessStep.description: An administrator can reactivate your workspace access.

inactive.note: If you still need access, contact your administrator. You can check your access again here afterwards.

noPermission.title: No area is currently available to you
noPermission.description: Your account exists in the system, but it currently has no permission for a workspace area.

accountStep.title: Account active
accountStep.description: Your account and membership were recognized.

accessStep.title: No active permission
accessStep.description: An administrator can grant access to the appropriate area.

noPermission.note: You do not need to set anything up again. Once your permissions change, simply check your access again.

search.label: Search leads
search.disabledHint: Lead search arrives with the next release.

bookingUrlDialog.title: My booking link
bookingUrlDialog.description: Customers of your projects book their onboarding call through this link. They see it in the portal once they have submitted the onboarding.
bookingUrlDialog.label: Link to the booking calendar
bookingUrlDialog.hint: https links only, for example from Calendly or Cal.com. Leave empty to remove the link.

issues.invalid: This is not a complete link. Paste it starting with https://.
issues.not_https: The link has to start with https://.
issues.too_long: The link is too long. The limit is 2,048 characters.

bookingUrlDialog.conflict: The link was just changed elsewhere. Save again if your entry should apply.
bookingUrlDialog.conflictCurrentEmpty: No link is stored at the moment.
bookingUrlDialog.loadError: Your link could not be loaded. Close the dialog and try again.
